safi-cedvel:1-2.t:
* I'rab:
(تنزيل) a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); (من الله) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
The clause «تنزيل الكتاب من الله ...» has no grammatical position: inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya).

safi-cedvel:3-5.t:
* I'rab:
(في السموات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of إنّ; (اللام) for emphasis; (للمؤمنين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آيات.
The clause «إنّ في السموات ... لآيات» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
4- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (في خلقكم) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (آيات); (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to خلقكم with a muḍāf implied, i.e. the creation of what He disperses; (من دابة) a tamyīz (specification) of ما — or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied resumptive pronoun —; (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of آيات ...
The clause «في خلقكم ... آيات» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «يبثّ ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يوقنون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.
5- (الواو) conjunction in all four places; (اختلاف) genitive by an omitted preposition indicated by the preceding preposition (في), attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ آيات [Note: Or conjoined to خلقكم.. and likewise آيات is conjoined to the first آيات, and there is no new clause in the speech.]; (ما) a relative noun in the position of genitive, conjoined to اختلاف by the wāw; (من السماء) attached to (أنزل); (من رزق) attached to (أنزل) [Note: The first (من) is for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya) and the second (من) is explicative (bayān), so it may validly be attached to a ḥāl of the implied resumptive pronoun.]; (الفاء) conjunction; (به) attached to (أحيا); (بعد) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to (أحيا); conjoined to اختلاف, genitive [Translator's note: this phrase stands detached in the source, apparently referring to تصريف الرياح.]; (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of آيات.
The clause «(في) اختلاف الليل ... آيات» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause في خلقكم ... آيات.
The clause «أنزل الله ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «أحيا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أنزل.
The clause «يعقلون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of the (second) قوم.

safi-cedvel:6-6.t:
* I'rab:
(تلك) a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the clause نتلوها [Note: The khabar may be (آيات), and the clause نتلوها a second khabar or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of آيات, the governing factor in it being the demonstrative, by analogy with the words of Allah the Exalted: «وتلك بيوتهم خاوية» with خاوية in the accusative.]; (عليك) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نتلوها); (بالحقّ) attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of نتلو or of its object; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (بأيّ) attached to (يؤمنون), and the interrogative carries the sense of denial; (بعد) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to (يؤمنون) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. after the discourse of Allah.
The clause «تلك آيات الله ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نتلوها ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ تلك.
The clause «يؤمنون» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if they do not believe in this discourse, then in what discourse will they believe?

safi-cedvel:7-10.t:
* I'rab:
(ويل) a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject) [Note: Beginning with an indefinite noun was permitted because the word indicates blame.]; (لكلّ) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) ...
The clause «ويل لكلّ أفّاك ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
8- (عليه) attached to (تتلى); (كأن) lightened from the heavy form (mukhaffafa), its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the effect to the cause; (بعذاب) attached to (بشره).
The clause «يسمع ...» is in the position of genitive as a second naʿt (adjective) of أفّاك.
The clause «تتلى ...» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) of آيات.
The clause «يصرّ ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause يسمع.
The clause «كأن لم يسمعها» is in the position of accusative as ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of يصرّ.
The clause «لم يسمعها» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the lightened كأن.
The clause «بشّره» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption, i.e.: take heed, and give him tidings.
9- (الواو) conjunction; (من آياتنا) attached to a ḥāl of (شيئا); (هزوا) a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), governed by اتّخذ; (لهم) attached to an omitted fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عذاب).
The clause «علم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «اتّخذها ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «أولئك لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «لهم عذاب» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك).
10- (من ورائهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ جهنم; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (عنهم) attached to (يغني); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle in both places; (شيئا) object of يغني [Note: Or a relative noun in both, in the position of nominative, the resumptive pronoun being omitted in both. — A mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, i.e. any of availing, the mafʿūl bihi being implied.] [Translator's note: the footnote in the source appears to combine two separate notes, one on (ما) and one on (شيئا).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to reinforce the negation.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كسبوا) is in the position of nominative as fāʿil of يغني, and the interpreted maṣdar (ما اتّخذوا) is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the first maṣdar; (من دون) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi governed by اتّخذوا; (الواو) conjunction; (لهم عذاب عظيم) like لهم عذاب مهين (in the previous verse).
The clause «من ورائهم جهنّم» is in the position of nominative as badal (substitute) of (لهم عذاب ...).
The clause «لا يغني عنهم ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لهم عذاب.
The clause «كسبوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the first particle-relative (ما).
The clause «اتّخذوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second particle-relative (ما).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the first clause لهم عذاب.

* Rhetoric:
Al-taḍādd (a word bearing opposite meanings): in the words of Allah the Exalted «مِنْ وَرائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ».
Al-taḍādd is the use of a word that admits a meaning and its opposite, being shared between the two meanings, so that it is used for a thing and its opposite.
In this noble verse the figure of taḍādd is found, because the meaning is either "in front of them", since they are heading towards what has been prepared for them, or "behind them", since they are turning away from that and devoting themselves to this world; for وراء is a name for the direction that a person conceals, whether behind or in front.

* Benefits:
- The lightened كأن.
In this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted كَأَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْها. (كأن) is lightened from the heavy form and has governed like إنّ: its noun is the pronoun of the matter, and the clause (لم يسمعها) is in the position of nominative as khabar of كأن. The implied form is (كأنه لم يسمعها). However, its noun may be present and its khabar a single word. The following verse was narrated:
ويوما توافينا بوجه مقسم ... كأن ظبية تعطو إلى وارق السلم
(And one day she meets us with a lovely face, as though a gazelle stretching towards a leafy salam tree.)
with (ظبية) in the accusative as the noun of كأن, the clause after it being an adjective of it and the khabar omitted, the implied form being: as though a stretching gazelle were this woman — by reversed simile, which is more eloquent; with (ظبية) in the nominative as the khabar, the clause after it being an adjective and its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter, the implied form being (كأنها ظبية); and with (ظبية) in the genitive on the view that أن is redundant between the kāf and its genitive noun, the implied form being (كظبية).
When its noun is omitted and its khabar is a nominal clause, it needs no separator, as in the saying of the poet:
ووجه مشرق اللون ... كأن ثدياه حقان
(And a face of radiant colour, as though her breasts were two small round boxes.)
The point of evidence is his saying (كأن ثدياه حقان), where the noun of كأن is the pronoun of the matter, and the clause (ثدياه حقان), made of a mubtadaʾ and khabar, is in the position of nominative as the khabar of كأن, the implied form being (كأنه ثدياه حقان). Therefore there is no separation between كأن and its khabar that is a clause.
But if the khabar is a verbal clause, it is separated by (قد), as in his saying:
لا يهولنّك اصطلاء لظى الحر ... ب فمحذورها كأن قد ألما
(Let not the warming at the blaze of war frighten you, for what is feared of it is as though it had already struck.)
The point of evidence is his saying (كأن قد ألما), where the khabar of كأن is a verbal clause, so it is separated from (كأن) by قد.
Or the separator is (لم), as in the words of Allah the Exalted (كأن لم تغن بالأمس), and the words of Allah the Exalted occurring in the verse under discussion (كأن لم يسمعها).

safi-cedvel:11-11.t:
* I'rab:
(بآيات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كفروا); (لهم عذاب) like the previous one [Note: In verse (9) of the sura.]; (من رجز) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب) ...
The clause «هذا هدى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الذين كفروا لهم عذاب» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لهم عذاب ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (الذين).

safi-cedvel:12-13.t:
* I'rab:
(لكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (سخّر); (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl); (تجري) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; (فيه) attached to (تجري); (بأمره) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الفلك ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تجري ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (سخّر); (الواو) conjunction; (لتبتغوا) like لتجري; (من فضله) attached to (تبتغوا). The interpreted maṣdar (لتبتغوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (سخّر), so it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first maṣdar.
The clause «الله الذي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «سخّر ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي).
The clause «تجري ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «تبتغوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لعلّكم تشكرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), i.e.: that you may be provided for and that you may give thanks.
The clause «تشكرون» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of لعلّ.
13- (الواو) conjunction in both places; (لكم) like the first; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في السموات) attached to an omitted ṣila of ما; (ما) like the first and conjoined to it; (في الأرض) like في السموات; (جميعا) a tawkīd (emphasis) in meaning (maʿnawī) of (ما) [Note: Or it is a ḥāl of (ما في السموات وما في الأرض).]; (منه) attached to a ḥāl of ما [Note: It may be a naʿt (adjective) of (جميعا).]; (في ذلك) attached to a fronted khabar of (إنّ); (اللام) for emphasis; (لقوم) attached to a naʿt of (آيات) ...
The clause «إنّ في ذلك لآيات ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «سخّر ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the (first) clause سخّر.
The clause «يتفكّرون ...» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(للذين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قل); (يغفروا) an imperfect verb, jussive as the answer to the command; the second (للذين) attached to (يغفروا); (لا) negative; (اللام) for giving the reason (taʿlīl); (يجزي) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle. The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجزي..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an implied verb, i.e. forgive ... [Note: Or attached to (قل).]
The interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (يجزي).
The clause «قل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يغفروا ...» [Translator's note: the source misprints it as «بغفروا».] has no grammatical position: apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ, i.e.: if you say to them "forgive", they will forgive ... so the clause that is the object of speech is implied, i.e. "forgive".
The clause «لا يرجون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «يجزي ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «يكسبون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.

* Rhetoric:
Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in the words of Allah the Exalted «لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْماً بِما كانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ».
What is meant by "a people" is the believers, who are definite (known); the indefiniteness is for praising and extolling them, i.e. they were commanded to do that so that He may recompense on the Day of Resurrection a people — and what a people! — a people singled out for what they earned in this world of good deeds, among which are patience in the face of the harm of the disbelievers, and overlooking them by restraining anger and bearing what is disliked, [with] such immense reward as words fall short of describing.

* Benefits:
- The words of Allah the Exalted: (قُلْ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ), i.e. they do not fear the punitive events of Allah and are heedless of His wrath. Ibn ʿAbbās said: it was revealed concerning ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb; that was because a man of Banū Ghifār insulted him, and ʿUmar was about to strike him, so Allah revealed this verse and commanded him to pardon him. It is also said: it was revealed concerning some of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from the people of Mecca, who were suffering severe harm from the polytheists before they were commanded to fight; they complained of that to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so Allah revealed this verse, and then abrogated it with the verse of fighting.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (صالحا) an accusative mafʿūl bihi (direct object) [Note: Or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its adjective, i.e. a righteous deed.]; (الفاء) linking the apodosis; (لنفسه) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "عمله"; (الواو) conjunction; (من أساء فعليها) like من عمل.. فلنفسه; (إلى ربّكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb (ترجعون).
The clause «من عمل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «عمل صالحا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «(عمله) لنفسه ...» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with fāʾ.
The clause «من أساء ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أساء ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «إساءته عليها» is in the position of jussive as apodosis, joined with fāʾ.
The clause «ترجعون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.

* Benefits:
- In this verse there is evidence for the omission of the mubtadaʾ after the fāʾ of the apodosis, in the words of Allah the Exalted (مَنْ عَمِلَ صالِحاً فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَساءَ فَعَلَيْها); the implied forms are (فعمله لنفسه) and (فإساءته عليها).
This discussion has come in detail in Sūrat Fuṣṣilat, verse (49), so go back to it once more.

safi-cedvel:16-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); (الكتاب) an accusative second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الواو) conjunction in all four places; (من الطيّبات) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (رزقناهم); (على العالمين) attached to (فضّلناهم).
The clause «آتينا ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the implied oath ... the implied oath clause has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «رزقناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause آتينا.
The clause «فضّلناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
17- (الواو) conjunction; (من الأمر) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (بيّنات); (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) negative; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (من بعد) attached to (اختلفوا); (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (بغيا) an accusative mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) [Note: Or a maṣdar in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb.]; (بينهم) an accusative adverb (ẓarf), attached to a naʿt of (بغيا). The interpreted maṣdar (ما جاءهم ...) is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The second (بينهم) is attached to (يقضي); (يوم) an accusative adverb of time, attached to (يقضي); (في ما) attached to (يقضي); (فيه) attached to (يختلفون).
The clause «آتيناهم ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
The clause «اختلفوا ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آتينا.
The clause «جاءهم العلم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «إنّ ربّك يقضي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يقضي ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «كانوا فيه يختلفون» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يختلفون» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كانوا.
18- (ثمّ) for conjunction — or resumptive —; (على شريعة) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi; (من الأمر) attached to a naʿt of (شريعة); (الفاء) conjunctive, linking the cause to the effect; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive, and the second is negative ...
The clause «جعلناك ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause answering the oath [Note: Or originally resumptive, according to the meaning.].
The clause «اتّبعها ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to a resumption caused by what preceded, i.e.: take heed, and follow it.
The clause «لا تتبع ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اتّبعها.
The clause «لا يعلمون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
19- (عنك) attached to (يغنوا) by its being made to carry the meaning of يدفعوا "repel" (taḍmīn); (من الله) attached to a ḥāl of (شيئا) with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. from the punishment of Allah; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (بعضهم) a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is (أولياء).
The clause «إنّهم لن يغنوا ...» has no grammatical position: giving the reason for the preceding prohibition.
The clause «لن يغنوا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «إنّ الظالمين ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «بعضهم أولياء ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the (second) إنّ.
The clause «الله وليّ ...» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the causal clause.
20- (للناس) attached to a naʿt of (بصائر); (لقوم) attached to (رحمة).
The clause «هذا بصائر ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يوقنون» is in the position of genitive as naʿt of قوم.

* Morphology:
(18) شريعة: a name for the water that people come down to drink; its plural is شرائع. Then it was borrowed for religion.. or it is a name for a doctrine and creed (milla); its pattern is فعيلة with fatḥa then kasra.
